scope: Read-only: the committed per-cell read-out applied to the same thirty statistics at three samplings (target, predicted, detected board box, interior-fit refined lattice), no training, no refit on this arm's inputs and no weight change.

readout.refit_note: the committed artifact ships out-of-fold logits, not coefficients, so the read-out is reconstructed by running its own committed estimator on the committed features, labels and folds and is accepted only when it reproduces those logits to 1e-6; the same fitted folds then transform the detected-box and predicted features, so no parameter is fitted on this arm's rows

detection.recipe: single-objective search over wall and grid candidates

refinement.recipe: per-boundary localisation, Theil-Sen pitch and origin fit

no_regression.rule: every board that M50 or M51 placed within the declared gate must stay within it (or within its own previous value plus the declared slack) after the refinement; the two boards M51 degraded are judged against M50's value

branch.reading: fit-under-specified: the median board is placed, but a minority of captures leave the pitch under-determined and the population mean stays above the gate
